title: Been in the neighborhood behind Mall World lately
content: Photo swipe of what the neighborhood backyard and stone gravel walkway in the woods looks / feels like above ^^ So y’all know how a lot of us have been to the beautiful neighborhood behind mall world, super green and hilly with life size “dollhouses” super close together? I’ve been hanging out around the area and just chilling with girlfriends but the other night we went on a group walk and it was myself, my friends, a bunch of what were probably guy friends and some kids we were looking after. There was like a stone gravel walkway in the woods we were meant to take, it was pitch black going in and apparently we had to turn around because the “clowns” were in there. Somehow after we turned around I was back in the parking lot of mall world going inside to get dinner and getting ready in the car beforehand. I’ve never had a kind of mall world dream like this. It was like I was viewing / living the dream from the perspective of a valley girl that came from wealthy money who just nannied all day. I can’t explain, usually I’m not as lucky to be that kind of character. Usually just confused on a mission or running from someone and on a “lower level” of elitism lol. Getting ignored or feeling lost. Has anyone ever wondered if sometimes we are in mall world fulfilling different roles?
